run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-14T20:19:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is explained by a genuine 100% failure of checkout's PlaceOrder server spans: at 2026-11-14T20:19:54Z the PlaceOrder ERROR span rate was 0.0375/s against 0 UNSET, i.e. ratio 1.0 with the 0.5 threshold. Checkout's only failing operation besides PlaceOrder itself is its client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is erroring (last-5m Charge error ratio exactly 1.0), with payment's own container log emitting warn "Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold" from /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 for every Charge request from 20:15:15 onward. The deepest supported cause is application-level rejection inside the payment service, and the strongest supported driver is fault injection via the flagd flag paymentFailure, which the flagd-config ConfigMap currently defines with defaultVariant "100%" ("Fail payment service charge requests n%"), while paymentUnreachable and all other fault flags default to off. flagd's log shows the mounted flag file being modified at 19:47:34, 19:56:13 and 20:14:37; Charge failures stop (20:02–20:14 error rate 0, checkout ratio 0) and resume ~20:15:15, 38s after the last file change, so a flag toggled on→off→100%-on during the hour is a supported hypothesis, not a proven change record (change_history is not integrated). Payment, checkout and flagd pods are running and ready with 0 restarts on unchanged ReplicaSets, so crash/OOM/rollout, unreachability, latency and the other checkout dependencies are rejected as causes. Impact is limited to the checkout path: payment (own Charge error spans/logs), checkout (own PlaceOrder error spans), and the upstream frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator spans that carry HTTP 500 / gRPC 13 in the same traces. Payload volume is very low (~0.04 PlaceOrder spans/s), which makes the 5-minute ratio coarse but does not invalidate it, since payment's own 5-minute Charge ratio is also 1.0.

claims.text: At the alert evaluation time 2026-11-14T20:19:54Z the alert's own metric shows the alert is true: span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with span_kind SPAN_KIND_SERVER had STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0.0375/s and STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate 0, i.e. an error ratio of 1.0, above the 0.5 threshold.

checkout's own error spans over the 15 minutes to 20:19:54Z are exactly two series: server oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 0.01071/s and client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge at 0.01071/s — the only failing checkout operation other than PlaceOrder is its call to payment.

payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge records STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.01071/s ERROR vs 0.01786/s UNSET over 15m), and over the last 5 minutes to 20:19:54Z the payment Charge error ratio is exactly 1 (100% of Charge server spans errored).

payment container logs of pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9md52 show warn-level 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with stack 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)' for Charge requests at 20:15:15, 20:16:37, 20:16:46, 20:16:54, 20:16:55, 20:17:39, 20:17:45, 20:18:09, 20:18:54, 20:19:09, 20:19:26, 20:19:29, 20:19:38 and 20:19:52, while Charge requests between 19:59:19 and 20:13:40 logged 'Transaction complete.' (loyalty levels bronze/silver/platinum/gold).

Payment error spans carry the same diagnostic text: grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' on service payment operation grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span carries otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; frontend's 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' span carries '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: ...'.

In the same two failing traces the other checkout dependencies show no errors: shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote rpc.grpc.status_code=0, currency Currency/Convert otel.status_code=OK, cart oteldemo.CartService/GetCart rpc.grpc.status_code=0, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct rpc.grpc.status_code=0; and the namespace-wide 15m error-span query returned no error series for cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, quote, email, accounting, image-provider or kafka.

The failure was intermittent across the hour: the checkout PlaceOrder error ratio was 0.506 at 19:50, 1.0 at 19:55, 0.5 at 20:00, 0 at 20:05/20:10/20:15 and 1.0 at 20:20, and payment's Charge ERROR 5m rate was non-zero up to 20:00:54, zero at 20:02:54–20:14:54, then non-zero again from 20:16:54 (0.00417) and 20:18:54 (0.0292).

The flagd-config ConfigMap in namespace otel-demo holds demo.flagd.json, which defines flag 'paymentFailure' described 'Fail payment service charge requests n%' with defaultVariant '100%' (variant '100%'=1, 'off'=0), while 'paymentUnreachable' and the other fault flags (productCatalogFailure, cartFailure, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, imageSlowLoad, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu) all default to 'off' — this is the ConfigMap's state at the query at 20:21:01Z, not a reading from the incident time.

flagd pod flagd-d6485586b-6ppgj logs fsnotify events on the mounted flag file: 'filepath event: etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json CHMOD' plus 'REMOVE' at 19:47:34.637Z, 19:56:13.565Z and 20:14:37.602Z — i.e. the flag file was rewritten three times inside the incident window, the last 38s before the resumed 20:15:15 Charge failures.

The payment workload itself is healthy as an object: pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9md52 is Running, ready, restartCount 0, started 2026-11-14T16:32:38Z; its ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 is owned by Deployment payment with 1 desired/1 ready and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-payment (no newer ReplicaSet); checkout and flagd pods are likewise Running/ready with 0 restarts; and no Kubernetes events were returned for the payment, flagd or checkout objects.
payment's deployment configuration points it at flagd: env FLAGD_HOST=flagd and FLAGD_PORT=8013 on deployment payment (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-payment, 1 replica available).

Separately from the Charge failures, error spans exist on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream for service_name ad, flagd and recommendation at 0.00119/s (8.3e-4-style 5m rate blocks of ~0.00417) recurring in blocks around 19:45–19:48, 19:55–19:58, 20:05–20:08 and 20:15–20:18, i.e. both while payment charges were succeeding and while they were failing.

Primary cause: fault injection through the flagd flag 'paymentFailure' currently resolving to variant '100%' makes the payment service's charge handler reject every Charge request with 'Invalid token'; checkout propagates that as gRPC code 13/INTERNAL on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, driving the error ratio to 1.0 and firing CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorOrderPlaceErrorRatioHigh. Supporting: the flag's description ('Fail payment service charge requests n%'), its defaultVariant '100%', payment's exactly-1.0 last-5m Charge error ratio, payment's own 'Invalid token' warn logs from charge.js:37, and payment's FLAGD_HOST=flagd configuration. This remains an inference: the ConfigMap is readable only in its current state and payment's source or flag-evaluation code was not inspected.

Timeline hypothesis: the paymentFailure flag was toggled on→off→100%-on during the hour, matching flagd's flag-file rewrites at 19:47:34, 19:56:13 and 20:14:37 to the observed pattern of Charge failures up to ~20:00, successes 20:02–20:14, and 100% failures from 20:15:15 onward — which is why the trailing-5m PlaceOrder ratio oscillated (0.506/1.0/0.5/0/0/0/1.0) and the alert fired at 20:19:54. The identity of the actor and the exact flag values at those times are not observable with the integrated sources.

Traffic is very low, so the 5-minute ratio is coarse: PlaceOrder server span rate is only 0.0375/s (~2.25/min), and the ratio legitimately alternates between 0 and 1.0 across the hour. This does not make the alert a sampling artifact, because payment's own last-5m Charge error ratio is 1.0 and payment's log shows every Charge request failing over the same minutes, but it does mean the '100%' figure rests on a handful of spans per window.

Not the whole incident window was failing: checkout's PlaceOrder error ratio was 0 at 20:05/20:10/20:15 and payment logged successful 'Transaction complete.' transactions at 19:59–20:13, so the 100% failure state is a phase that began around 20:15, not a continuous condition across the full hour.

Payment unreachable / network or endpoint failure — rejected: payment's own server span exists for every failing Charge and returns an application error in 648–982 µs, so payment received and answered the calls, and the paymentUnreachable flag is currently default 'off'.

Payment crash, OOM, eviction or rollout — rejected: pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9md52 is Running and ready with restartCount 0 since 2026-11-14T16:32:38Z, its ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 is still owned by Deployment payment (no replacement ReplicaSet/new pod), there is no previous container instance to read, and no Kubernetes events were returned for payment, flagd or checkout.

Latency/timeout degradation of payment or checkout — rejected: failing payment Charge spans last only 601–982 µs and failing checkout PlaceOrder spans 13–16 ms, with the error text naming an explicit application rejection, not a deadline or transport error.

Failure of another checkout dependency (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, quote, email) causing PlaceOrder errors — rejected: those calls carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / otel.status_code=OK inside the failing traces, and none of those services had any STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the 15m namespace-wide error query.

The flagd EventStream error spans on ad, flagd and recommendation caused the Charge failures — rejected: they recur in ~10-minute blocks through 19:40–20:20 both while payment charges were succeeding (20:05–20:08) and failing (20:15–20:18), at only 0.00119/s, and involve the ad/recommendation flagd EventStream clients rather than payment's Charge path; their own cause remains unknown.

Operator action to verify and, if the 100% failure injection is not intended, revert the flagd-config flag 'paymentFailure' defaultVariant from '100%' to 'off', then confirm payment's Charge error ratio and checkout's PlaceOrder error ratio return to 0. This was not executed in this investigation.

Use a cluster audit / change-history source to identify who or what rewrote etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json at 19:47:34, 19:56:13 and 20:14:37 and which flag values were set, and consider a minimum-request-volume guard on CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh given the ~0.04 spans/s PlaceOrder rate.

gaps: change_history is not an integrated source in this Run, so who/what changed flagd-config demo.flagd.json and which variant it held at 19:47:34, 19:56:13 and 20:14:37 could not be verified; the ConfigMap is only observable in its state at query time (20:21:01Z).

payment's source/flag-evaluation code was not inspected, so the exact mechanism turning variant '100%' into the message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' is inferred, not verified.

One error-detail field per payment span was omitted (omitted_error_detail_field_count=1 for each) and only the first 40 of 314 rows of the payment error-span result were read, so the remaining spans' error attributes are unknown.
The cause of the recurring flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error spans on ad, flagd and recommendation (0.00119/s) is unknown; they were not tied to the Checkout PlaceOrder failures.

Kubernetes events retained for namespace otel-demo only cover 19:29:02–19:29:08, so pod-level history for the rest of the window is unknown rather than absent, and the ConfigMap/flag change itself is not recorded as an event.
next_steps: Inspect flagd-config (demo.flagd.json) paymentFailure and set it to 'off' if the 100% payment failure injection is not intended; then watch payment Charge and checkout PlaceOrder error ratios for recovery.
Pull cluster audit logs or a change-management record for the three demo.flagd.json rewrites (19:47:34, 19:56:13, 20:14:37) to identify the owner of the change.
Add a low-volume guard or longer evaluation window to CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh, since PlaceOrder server span volume is ~0.04 spans/s and the 5m ratio alternates between 0 and 1.0.
Investigate the periodic flagd EventStream error spans on ad, flagd and recommendation as a separate issue if they persist.
